entities.summary: Genghis Khan, a notable figure in the history of Kazakhstan, associated with Mongol Conquest and Golden Horde (1218–1260). Preceded by Khwarazmian Empire and Kazakh steppe divided between the Golden Horde (Jochi ulus) and Chagatai Khanate. Their legacy influenced Mongol forces destroy Otrar after the massacre of Genghis Khan's trade envoys and White Horde and Post-Mongol Fragmentation.
